results.title: Hundreds demonstrate outside Lindsay Clancy trial: ‘She’s not alone’
results.description: Supporters shared stories of postpartum experiences and a moment of silence in support of Clancy.

results.title: Saudi Arabia removes references to Jerusalem and Palestine from school textbooks
results.description: Saudi Arabia has removed the phrase “Muslims will never give up Jerusalem” from school textbooks, in what Israeli research organisation IMPACT-se (Institute for Monitoring Peace and Cultural Tolerance in School Education) described as a significant shift in the way Islam, Palestine and Israel are presented in the country’s educational curriculum.

results.title: James Paul Ellis-Kendrick: Man spared jail after pressuring children to send explicit photos
results.description: A man who pressured underage girls as young as 11 to send him sexually explicit photos of themselves has been spared jail.

results.title: Spain Refuses to Return 500 Migrant Girls to Morocco Despite EU Recommendation
results.description: Spain defies EU recommendations to return 500 migrant girls to Morocco, prioritising child welfare. The decision highlights tensions between EU directives and Spain's commitment to protecting vulnerable minors.
